title: Explainable Machine Learning Analysis of Temperature Effects on Mechanical Strength of Fiber-Reinforced High-Performance Concrete
abstract: arXiv:2610.23811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting the compressive strength of fiber-reinforced high-performance concrete subjected to temperature exposure is challenging because to the intricate interdependencies of mixture composition, fiber properties, curing conditions, and temperature. A data-driven framework to predict compressive strength utilizing 1,204 experimental records containing a diverse array of material designs and exposure situations. This study evaluates eight machine-learning models and demonstrate that ensemble approaches routinely surpass individual learners. Both gradient boosting and extreme gradient boosting exhibit superior performance on unseen data, each attaining a R^2 of 0.903. Gradient boosting produces the minimal root mean square error (6.67 MPa), whereas extreme gradient boosting achieves the lowest mean absolute error (3.97 MPa) and mean absolute percentage error (10.60%). translated_title: 纤维增强高性能混凝土力学强度温度效应的可解释机器学习分析
translated_abstract: 由于混合料组成、纤维特性、养护条件与温度之间复杂的相互依赖关系，预测经受温度作用的纤维增强高性能混凝土的抗压强度极具挑战性。本研究利用包含多样材料设计与温度暴露环境的1,204条实验记录，构建了预测抗压强度的数据驱动框架。研究评估了八种机器学习模型，并证明集成方法通常优于单一学习器。梯度提升和极端梯度提升在未见数据上均表现出优越性能，两者均达到了0.903的R²。其中，梯度提升产生了最小的均方根误差（6.67 MPa），而极端梯度提升则实现了最低的平均绝对误差（3.97 MPa）和平均绝对百分比误差（10.60%）。此外，研究进一步利用Shapley加性解释方法对模型进行解释…
tldr: 本研究基于1,204条实验记录构建了可解释的机器学习框架，利用梯度提升与极端梯度提升模型（R²达0.903）准确预测温度作用下纤维增强高性能混凝土的抗压强度，并结合SHAP方法揭示各因素对强度的影响机制。
